'''B''' is the 2nd [[letter]] of the [[English alphabet]]. It's appearance depends on the writer's calligraphy. It has an uppercase and lowercase version like most other letters.
==Origin==
The letter B was already part of the [[Phoenician alphabet]] more than 3000 years ago in 1000 BC. It is part of many alphabets today.
==Usage==
* In the [[game]] of [[bingo]], B is a [[column]]
* In [[medicine]], B is one of the human [[blood type]]s
* In [[chemistry]], B is the [[chemical symbol]] for [[boron]]
* In particle physics, b is the symbol for the [[bottom quark]]
* In transport, B is the vehicle registration plate of [[Belgium]]
* In [[music]], B is a [[Note (music)|note]] sometimes referred to as "Si" or "Ti"
* In [[education]], B is a passing grade, usually around 80-70 marks
* In the New York Stock Exchange, B is the symbol for the [[:en:Barnes_Group|Barnes Group]]
* On the [[internet]], B (or /b/) is any of a number of [[image]] boards that allow [[Anonymity|anonymous]] posts
